_comment: Minimal, compile-verified OCaml calls for ported components. Every entry is build-checked, not asserted: a snippet copied verbatim from examples/demo/demo.ml or examples/showcase/showcase.ml is compiled there, and any snippet that is not a verbatim copy is reproduced in examples/snippetcheck/, which `dune build` compiles (perturbing it fails the build, so the guard is live). Served to agents by tools/mcp/astryx-mcp.mjs (get_snippet); a ported component with no entry is answered as "ported, no snippet", never as "not ported".

snippets.Heading: Astryx.Heading.view ~level:Astryx.Heading.H2 [ Vdom.Node.text "Section title" ]
snippets.Button:
Astryx.Button.view ~variant:Astryx.Button.Primary ~label:"Save" []
(* loading: ~is_loading:true — keeps focus, sets aria-busy + aria-disabled *)
(* disabled: ~is_disabled:true — native disabled *)
snippets.Grid:
Astryx.Grid.view
  ~columns:(Astryx.Grid.Fixed 3)
  ~gap:Astryx.Common.Spacing.S3
  [ a; b; c ]
(* responsive: ~columns:(Astryx.Grid.Responsive (280, Astryx.Grid.Fill)) *)
snippets.DropdownMenu:
(* module Dm = Astryx.Dropdown_menu *)

(* the menu is a state machine, so it takes the graph and a callback tree *)
let selected, set_selected = Bonsai.state (None : string option) graph in
let on_select =
  Bonsai.map set_selected ~f:(fun set_selected (item : Dm.item) ->
    set_selected (Some item.id))
in

let entries : Dm.entry list =
  [ Dm.Item
      { Dm.id = "open"
      ; label = "Open"
      ; description = None
      ; end_content = Some (Vdom.Node.text "\xe2\x8c\x980")
      ; icon = Some "success"
      ; variant = Dm.Default
      ; is_disabled = false
      ; href = None
      ; has_close_on_select = None
      }
  ; Dm.Divider
  ; Dm.Item
      { Dm.id = "duplicate"
      ; label = "Duplicate"
      ; description = None
      ; end_content = None
      ; icon = None
      ; variant = Dm.Default
      ; is_disabled = true (* cannot take focus, so the arrow keys skip it *)
      ; href = None
      ; has_close_on_select = None
      }
  ; Dm.Heading "Danger zone"
  ]

let menu = Dm.view ~id:"menu-file" ~trigger_label:"File" ~on_select ~entries graph
snippets.Field:
(* Field is the wrapper: the control goes in as children. *)
Astryx.Field.view
  ~label:"Full name"
  ~input_id:"name"
  ~description:"As it should appear on an invoice."
  ~is_required:true
  ~children:[ Vdom.Node.input ~attrs:[ Vdom.Attr.id "name" ] () ]
  ()
snippets.TextInput:
(* value and on_change are values in the graph, so a state setter goes straight in *)
let name, set_name = Bonsai.state "" graph in
Astryx.TextInput.view
  ~label:"Full name"
  ~id:"name"
  ~description:"As it should appear on an invoice."
  ~is_required:true
  ~status:{ Astryx.Input_types.type_ = Astryx.Input_types.Error; message = Some "That name is taken." }
  ~value:name
  ~on_change:(Bonsai.map set_name ~f:(fun set value -> set value))
  ()
snippets.TextArea:
(* rows is the height; there is no value attribute to set - the text goes in as the child *)
let draft, set_draft = Bonsai.state "" graph in
Astryx.TextArea.view
  ~label:"Release notes"
  ~id:"release-notes"
  ~description:"Markdown is fine; the review step renders it."
  ~is_required:true
  ~rows:4
  ~placeholder:"What changed?"
  ~value:draft
  ~on_change:(Bonsai.map set_draft ~f:(fun set value -> set value))
  ()
